results.text: The effect of enalapril on cardiac mechanics in the pediatric heart network infant single-ventricle trial: Insights using noninvasive pressure-volume loop analysis. Patients with single-ventricle physiology who received enalapril in the Pediatric Heart Network Infant Single-ventricle Trial displayed no differences in heart failure outcomes compared to those who received a placebo. The objective of this study was to use noninvasive pressure-volume loop analysis to assess for differences in cardiac mechanics
